updates.content:
Title: Some Workspace Admins see outdated/incomplete information in workspace settings of Power BI or Microsoft Fabric services

User impact: Workspace Admins see outdated/incomplete information in workspace settings of Power BI or Microsoft Fabric services.

More info: Workspace Admins may see outdated or incomplete information when viewing workspace settings, including Capacity Details, Domain settings, Contacts, OneDrive settings, and Semantic Model Storage Format. Configuration changes continue to be applied successfully; however, updated values may not be reflected in workspace settings after changes are saved or the page is refreshed.

Current status: We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the source of the issue and establish a fix.

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to some admins attempting to view the current state of workspace settings in the Power BI or Microsoft Fabric service.

Next update by: Tuesday, August 25, 2026, at 3:30 PM UTC
